systems.system: Cellular identification or location and electronic surveillance means
systems.country_label: Identificação ou Localização Celular e Vigilância Electrónica
systems.platform: Location and signal-tracking software, video and audio surveillance cameras, satellite location, interception and radio-listening equipment (article 12)
systems.owner: The criminal police bodies, through their technological investigation units linked to the public security integration body of the ministry responsible for security and public order
systems.tiers: National; a legal regime, with no deployment stated

systems.system: Database of identification and criminal-interest data
systems.country_label: base de dados de dados de identificação e interesse criminal
systems.owner: The criminal police body, in coordination with the public security integration body and with the data-protection authority informed (article 29)
systems.tiers: Required by the law for records obtained through surveillance: suspects' identity, the facts and place of the occurrence, biometric data and criminal antecedents; no statement that it exists

note: A law on cellular location and electronic surveillance by the criminal police. The database it requires holds surveillance-derived identification data, not the reports or case files stations take; a law places nothing.
